card.name: Entry routes through body openings
card.fires_on: Words in phrases about passing through an access route into the body, such as lumbar access, burrowing through the skin, or through the round window. It fires on the route word or the linking word just before it.

modes.label: Lumbar access
modes.description: The word 'bar' completing 'lumbar' when fluid is removed or drug is given through a lumbar access or puncture.
modes.example: The fluid was removed through a lum<<bar>> access.

modes.description: Parasites entering the body through the skin, on 'through' or 'skin'.
